title: Cloud staging validation result
description: Machine-readable contract emitted by tests/cloud/staging-workflows.mjs and tests/cloud/staging-failure-drill.sh. A run is successful (verdict=pass) only when every required field below passes; see docs/specs/cloud-staging-environment-tech-design.md section 3 (Validation result contract) for the source of truth.

schemaVersion.description: Bump when the contract changes incompatibly. Consumers should refuse results with an unknown schemaVersion.

runId.description: Stable per-run identifier. Same value is used as the synthetic tag prefix on every fixture this run creates, so cleanup can find and remove them without guessing.

intentCommit.description: Commit SHA the run was supposed to validate. The harness compares this against each service's reported version.

id.description: Provider environment identifier (e.g. Fly org+app names concatenated, or a managed-environment UUID). Never includes secrets.

provider.description: Cloud provider for the staging topology. Pinned to fly.io because the design's foundation task chose it; widen if a follow-up task onboards another provider.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the harness began the run.

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the harness emitted the verdict. endedAt >= startedAt.

services.description: Version snapshot per service. Each entry MUST agree with intentCommit when the service exposes a version field.

checks.description: Ordered list of per-check results. Each entry carries the check name, outcome, timing, and redacted details.

name.description: Stable check name (e.g. tasks.create, budget.me, scheduler.approve, failure_drill.worker_restart).

status.description: skip is reserved for checks deliberately disabled (e.g. failure-drill opted out). fail means the verdict is non-pass overall.

details.description: Check-specific structured detail. Redacted by the harness — never contains bearer tokens, full emails, or row bodies.

correlationId.description: Provider-side correlation id when the check produced one (workflow run id, request id, alert id).

error.description: Present only when status=fail. Stable error code + short message.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. TASKS_CREATE_NON_2XX, BUDGET_ME_NON_2XX, SCHEDULER_HEALTH_ADAPTER_MISMATCH, CLEANUP_PARTIAL.

message.description: Human-readable message. Must NOT include bearer tokens, raw emails, or row payloads.

cleanup.description: Result of the unconditional post-run cleanup pass. cleanup.ok MUST be true for the overall verdict to be pass.

name.description: Cleanup operation (e.g. tasks.archive, budget.session_revoke, scheduler.item_remove, scheduler.session_revoke_via_cli).

productionBlockers.description: Findings that block cutover. Empty array required for verdict=pass. Each entry carries owner, code, summary, and a stable reference.

owner.description: Human or role responsible for resolving the blocker (e.g. Quinn, Tom, Rowan).

reference.description: Optional task id, issue number, or doc reference.

acceptedLimitations.description: Findings the team has consciously accepted for this run. Required to have owner + rationale + follow-up. Allowed to be non-empty for verdict=pass.

followUp.description: Task id, ticket, or doc reference for the eventual fix.

verdict.description: Final verdict. pass requires every required service version matches intentCommit, every check is pass or explicit skip, cleanup.ok=true, and productionBlockers=[].
